This procedure details the steps required to completely check. he proper 
 operation of the SEL 321 distance relay It is recommended this procedure be 
 carried out on a yearly bases

The document is formatted the way to minimize the 
 possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment

Testing the Phase to Ground and Phase to Phase Measuring 
Elements

Select phase to ground fault A-N by using relay 
selector switch on supply unit test set

items:
Select phase to ground fault A-N by using relay 
selector switch on supply unit test set
Connect the outgoing voltage from the supply unit
Switch on the injection switch

Start the test by pressing the switch on the 
 control unit momentarily

Observe that the red indications A,G and Z1 on 
 the relay will light up

Change the value of the potential tap up or down 
 unit the relay operates in second step( The red indication Z2 on the relay will light up with the lest indications)
Record this pickup points on test sheet

sections.text:

sections.text: Measuring the Operating Times
Set potential switch to 50% of the zone 1 reach

Select phase to phase fault A-B by using relay 
selector switch on supply unit test set

Connect test leads between timer contact on the 
relay to the stop terminal of the timer
Reset the interval timer
Switch on
Start the test by pressing switch on
The timer will stop once the relay has picked up
Record the zone 1 tripping time on test sheet
